frontmatter.name: facebook-post
frontmatter.description: Publish a Facebook personal-profile or group post when the user clearly requests publication using the local OpenCLI fb-autopost plugin. Infer publish, draft and cancel intent from natural language, automatically detect supplied images, and always use slow input without a preview-image step.
